name: C2Scene_Unk0568
notes: Checked per-pixel H scroll/tile X wraps ($5FF, 191), edge column picks (X-1 / X+32, scroll-8 / +256), even/odd builder, hang on layer&3=0, M=1 exit, Callers note vs LeaderStep/BoardX.

name: C2Scene_Unk066C
notes: Checked V scroll wrap $3FF, tile Y 0-127, rows Y-1 / Y+28 at scroll-8 / +224, Top/Bottom builder choice, hang quirk, M=1 exit; Callers note matches LeaderStep/LeaderBoardY.

name: C2Anim_Run
notes: Checked op loop, store-back only on Z=1, carry claims vs handlers (OpEnd C=1; ShowFrame/Wait/JumpBack C=0), X = task on exit, M=1; doubtful $C2:4E1B as xref lists it.

name: C2Scene_TaskMove
notes: Checked 16.16 add chain on struct fields (frac first, carry into whole), no wrap, exit M=0, X = task, A = .SprY, Y untouched; doubtful $C2:46FA matches xref.

name: C2Scene_TaskRunScript
notes: Checked spawners install it (TaskSpawnScript/Low), loop, ScriptPtr store + 16-bit OpState clear per advance, ScriptBank never written, M=1 exit, leader/member callers.

name: C2Scene_WrapTaskPos
notes: Checked X +/- 1536 once (BPL / CMP+SBC), Y AND $3FF, Entry M=0 needed (no REP), exit A = .SprY, X = task.

name: C2Scene_SetAnim
notes: Checked AnimPtr from $C3E000 table entry A, AnimBank $C3 (table's own bank), AnimTimer 0, exit M=1, A = bank, X = task, Y untouched; doubtful sites match xref.

name: C2Scene_LeaderTask
notes: Checked empty-slot early C=0, .State zeroed on 027E/027F or 0280/0281 difference, TDC for B, dispatch on 027E; all handlers return C=0; no code reference found.

name: C2Scene_LeaderStates
notes: Checked six entries against the ObjWatchSt* constants (0,2,3,4,5; 1 = none).

name: C2Scene_LeaderWalk
notes: Checked mode 0/ModeIdle1 gate, else C2Anim_Run + C=0; index 0280*8 + .State*2, no-CLC note (C = .State bit 7), C2Tmp_00 exit, B=0 entry. nit: ASL comment names a byte count (8).

name: C2Scene_LeaderWalkSteps
notes: Checked 2x4 words, zero entries 3/7; .State reaches only 0-2 in both trig states (Init/Input INC, Step sets 1, ScriptStart/Run INC).

name: C2Scene_LeaderOnObjA
notes: Checked StartX/Y = ObjAX/Y each frame, falls into LeaderNone (C=0), X = ObjAY, A untouched, DP not used.

name: C2Scene_LeaderNone
notes: Checked CLC/RTS only; entry from table (state 1) and fall-in from LeaderOnObjA.

name: C2Scene_LeaderOnObjB
notes: Checked as OnObjA with ObjBX/Y, C=0, X = ObjBY, DP not used.

name: C2Scene_LeaderBoard
notes: Checked dispatch on .State*2 through LeaderBoardSteps, B=0 from LeaderTask's TDC, DP for TaskCur.

name: C2Scene_LeaderBoardSteps
notes: Checked four entries and their step comments against the handlers.

name: C2Scene_LeaderLeave
notes: Checked dispatch on ObjSel*2, B=0 entry, DP not used.

name: C2Scene_LeaderLeaveTable
notes: Checked entries 0/1 None, 2 = ObjSelA, 3 = ObjSelB handlers.

name: C2Scene_LeaderLeaveNone
notes: Checked CLC/RTS only.

name: C2Scene_LeaderLeaveA
notes: Checked sizes (32 + 43), State 0, sprite+StartX/Y = object pos, DEC flags count, Unk26 0, facing Down, SetEntryTile (X kept, A = EntryY); per-frame drop vs ObjEmptyA/B.

name: C2Scene_LeaderLeaveB
notes: Sub-entry of LeaderLeaveA; checked with its header: ObjBX/Y, DEC ObjBFlags, shared tail.

name: C2Scene_LeaderInit
notes: Checked State INC, attr by Loc_Id $1F5, tile/pos/vel init, SetEntryTile, Unk26, facing mask, TrailPos byte 0 + TrailFill, member-2 byte in C2Tmp_01, stand anim, props, TSB on trig.

name: C2Scene_LeaderInput
notes: Checked button order and gates (1B32 BMI, 7F0000>=$49), idle count/anim ($F0, $FE/$FF), step vel/anim reuse, target+props, blocked path, State 2 fall-in. nit: 'held' rests on walk.

name: C2Scene_LeaderStep
notes: Checked TaskMove/Wrap, XVel/YVel low bytes to layers 1,2 scrolls, 1BF1/3, Anim_Run, StartX/Y + SetEntryTile, target test, TrailPush, State 1, TSB/TRB flags, exit M per path.

name: C2Scene_LeaderScriptStart
notes: Checked MemberWords[0]=0 wait (M=0, A=0), ScriptPtr/Bank $7F/Wait 0, State 1, TaskRunScript carry dropped, props at position; SetMemberWord link hedged.

name: C2Scene_LeaderScriptRun
notes: Checked C=1 -> INC .State (1->2), StartX/Y = sprite pos every frame via Y, C=0, exit M=1, Y = .SprY.

name: C2Scene_LeaderScriptDone
notes: Checked CLC/RTS; leaves only via LeaderTask zeroing .State on watcher change.

name: C2Scene_LeaderBoardStart
notes: Checked size/sub-entry layout, target by ObjSel, vel 0, Y dir+facing from 16-bit diff flags, State 1, walk anim, fall-in; Sel0/Sel1 quirks (X=2 -> $1C-$2A, $04) verified.

name: C2Scene_LeaderBoardTargets
notes: Checked four entries: Sel0, Sel1, ObjA, ObjB.

name: C2Scene_LeaderBoardSel0
notes: Sub-entry of LeaderBoardStart; checked: LDX task, aim without setting target (quirk documented there).

name: C2Scene_LeaderBoardSel1
notes: Sub-entry of LeaderBoardStart; checked: X = 2 quirk documented there.

name: C2Scene_LeaderBoardObjA
notes: Sub-entry of LeaderBoardStart; checked: target = ObjAX/Y then aim.

name: C2Scene_LeaderBoardObjB
notes: Sub-entry of LeaderBoardStart; checked: target = ObjBX/Y, .aim body (vel 0, Y dir, facing, State+1, SetWalkAnim), fall into BoardY.

name: C2Scene_LeaderBoardY
notes: Checked move/wrap, StartX/Y + SetEntryTile (X kept), YVel scrolls layers 1,2, 1BF1/3, on target row vel 0 + X dir/facing, State 2, walk anim, Anim_Run, C=0 M=1.

name: C2Scene_LeaderBoardX
notes: Checked move/wrap, at TargetX State 3 + ObjCountUp (X reloaded after), StartX/Y + SetEntryTile, XVel scrolls layers 1,2, 1BF1/3, Anim_Run, C=0, M=1.

name: C2Scene_LeaderBoardDone
notes: Checked CLC/RTS only.

name: C2Scene_TrailFill
notes: Checked 16 iterations storing StartX/Y to TrailX/Y, exit X = 32, Y = 0, A = StartY, M=0.

name: C2Scene_TrailPush
notes: Checked byte TrailPos (AND $FF), stores SprX/Y, Y+2 AND $1F (16 words), exit M=1, A = new pos, Y = old+2, X kept.

name: C2Scene_SetWalkAnim
notes: Checked index Facing*2 (8-bit ASL) + Unk26&1, TDC for B, +$0C for char 6, tail JMP SetAnim; exit as SetAnim.

name: C2Scene_WalkAnims
notes: Checked bytes 04 05 01 02 07 08 0A 0B in up/down/left/right order and stand n / walk n+1,n+2 against StandAnims.

name: C2Scene_SetStandAnim
notes: Checked Facing AND 3 index, char-6 offset $0C, tail JMP SetAnim; exit as SetAnim.

name: C2Scene_StandAnims
notes: Checked bytes 03 00 06 09 for Facing 0-3 = up, down, left, right.

name: C2Scene_OnTrigTiles
notes: Checked word PropUL/UR AND/CMP $0404 (both bit 2), C result, exit M=1, X = task; caller TSB/TRB use; doubtful $C2:4E2E matches xref.

name: C2Scene_TileBlocked
notes: Checked word PropUL/UR AND $0303 (bits 0-1 of either), C=1 when set, exit M=1, X = task.

name: C2Scene_GetTileProps
notes: Checked /8, map $7E:5800 (BgMaps + $1800), table $7E7000, four tiles UL/UR/DL/DR with col-1 wrap to 191 and row-1 AND $7F, exit M=1, A = PropDR.

name: C2Scene_SetStepTarget
notes: Checked target = pos, +/-8 per non-zero whole velocity (LDY sign), exit Y = .YVel, A as stated. nit: Entry M=0 could be 'M any' (REP here).
